positions.title: Front-End Developer/Data Visualization Developer
positions.description:
* Leading the design, development, and deployment of full stack web applications for public and nonprofit sector stakeholders in areas such as public health, housing, and workforce development.
* Using TypeScript/React.js, Cloudflare serverless functions, and bespoke data visualization tools,
built the state of Delaware’s first wastewater drug testing dashboard.
* Alongside data scientist colleagues, architected the interface for a healthcare workforce mapping tool that was honored with a 2023 Drexel LeBow Analytics 50 Award.
* Serving as technical mentor/team lead for a cohort of 3 front-end fellows.

projects.title: New Castle County Wastewater High-Risk Substances Dashboard
projects.description:
I collaborated with New Castle County's government and Biobot Analytics to develop Delaware's first high-risk substances dashboard, an innovative web app that surfaces the results of wastewater surveillance throughout New Castle County, Delaware. The platform will be used by policymakers to determine the effectiveness of harm reduction strategies. Importantly, it is not used for enforcement purposes. 

I was the lead developer on this project, responsible for managing all aspects of the dashboard's visual identity, building out backend data processing pipelines and automations, and creating bespoke data visualizations.

testScores.name: Test of Russian as a Foreign Language Level 3 (ТРКИ-3)
testScores.description: Received a passing score on the Test of Russian as a Foreign Language Level 3, certifying my proficiency in Russian at the C1 level (ILR 3/3+)
